pagasa_climate.title: PAGASA Climate of the Philippines
pagasa_climate.scope: Philippine dry/rainy climatological context; not product demand magnitude.

pids_rainfall_work.title: PIDS: When Rain Falls, Work Slows
pids_rainfall_work.scope: General Philippine rainfall/work-exposure mechanism; not SKU demand evidence.

pids_rainfall_construction.title: PIDS: Routine rainfall cuts Filipino work hours
pids_rainfall_construction.scope: Identifies Philippine construction labor among outdoor occupations vulnerable to rainfall-related reductions in working hours; does not establish hardware-product sales magnitude.

outdoor_weather_exposed_construction.label: Outdoor/weather-exposed construction
outdoor_weather_exposed_construction.seasonal_explanation: PAGASA identifies the Philippine rainy and dry seasons, and PIDS identifies construction labor among outdoor occupations vulnerable to rainfall-related work-hour reductions. Products tied specifically to weather-exposed construction therefore receive only potential dry-season relevance inherited from that activity; this is not product-sales proof.

mixed_indoor_outdoor_maintenance.label: Mixed indoor/outdoor maintenance
mixed_indoor_outdoor_maintenance.seasonal_explanation: The activity spans indoor and outdoor work, so no single Philippine seasonal demand direction is supported.

masonry_construction.label: Masonry construction
masonry_construction.explanation: The product is a consumed masonry building material whose normal use can occur in weather-exposed construction.

cementitious_construction.label: Concrete, mortar, and cementitious construction
cementitious_construction.explanation: The product is consumed in concrete, mortar, plaster, or related construction work that can be weather exposed.

roof_installation.label: Roof installation or replacement
roof_installation.explanation: Roof installation and replacement are intrinsically weather-exposed construction activities.

general_purpose_tool_use.label: General-purpose assembly and maintenance
general_purpose_tool_use.explanation: The tool can be used across indoor and outdoor assembly, repair, and maintenance.

lightweight_fencing_and_enclosures.label: Lightweight fencing, guards, and enclosures
lightweight_fencing_and_enclosures.explanation: Wire mesh can serve outdoor enclosures or non-seasonal guards and reinforcement, so use alone does not establish demand direction.

rules.label: Claw hammer
rules.intended_use: Driving and removing nails in construction and repair work.
rules.seasonal_explanation: No product-specific evidence establishes higher claw-hammer demand in either Philippine season.

rules.label: Hammer
rules.intended_use: Striking, shaping, demolition, or general repair work depending on the hammer type.
rules.seasonal_explanation: General tool use alone does not establish seasonal demand direction.

rules.label: Phillips screwdriver
rules.intended_use: Driving and removing Phillips-head screws in assembly and repair work.
rules.seasonal_explanation: No product-specific Philippine seasonal demand evidence is available.

rules.label: Screwdriver
rules.intended_use: Driving and removing screws in general assembly and maintenance.
rules.seasonal_explanation: General-purpose hand tools have no established seasonal demand direction here.

rules.label: Tape measure
rules.intended_use: Measuring length and distance for construction, installation, and household projects.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Project relevance does not prove a dry- or rainy-season sales effect.

rules.label: Cordless drill/driver
rules.intended_use: Drilling holes and driving fasteners in construction, installation, and repair work.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Indoor and outdoor uses are mixed and no product-specific seasonal direction is established.

rules.label: Staple gun
rules.intended_use: Fastening fabric, insulation, sheeting, and light materials with staples.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Mixed indoor and outdoor uses do not establish seasonal demand.

rules.label: Adjustable wrench
rules.intended_use: Turning nuts, bolts, and fittings of varying sizes in repair and installation work.
rules.seasonal_explanation: The tool spans plumbing, maintenance, and construction, so direction is unknown.

rules.label: Concrete nails
rules.intended_use: Fastening wood or fixtures to concrete, masonry, or other hard substrates.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Concrete-work activity may be weather exposed, and Philippine rainfall can slow exposed work; this is provisional and not SKU demand proof.

rules.label: Safety goggles
rules.intended_use: Protecting the eyes from dust, debris, splashes, and impact during work.
rules.seasonal_explanation: PPE use is activity-related, but no seasonal sales direction is established.

rules.label: PVC pipe
rules.intended_use: Conveying water or drainage in plumbing installations and repairs.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Planned installation may slow in wet conditions while leak and drainage repairs may rise; the net demand direction is unknown.

rules.label: Thread-seal tape
rules.intended_use: Sealing threaded plumbing connections to help prevent leaks.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Routine installation and leak repair can have different timing; no net seasonal direction is established.

rules.label: Portland cement
rules.intended_use: Binding aggregate and sand in concrete, mortar, plaster, and masonry construction.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Mixing, placing, and curing work can be weather exposed; rainfall-work evidence supports only a provisional dry-season relevance, not a sales uplift.

rules.label: Waterproofing sealant
rules.intended_use: Sealing joints, cracks, and surfaces against water ingress and leaks.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Rain can reveal leaks and motivate waterproofing repair, but no Philippine SKU sales magnitude is verified.

rules.label: Roofing repair sealant
rules.intended_use: Repairing and sealing roof joints, flashing, cracks, and leak points; it is not a roofing-installation material classification.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Rain can expose roof leaks and prompt repair, but product-specific demand evidence remains provisional.

rules.label: Exterior paint/coating
rules.intended_use: Protecting and finishing exterior walls and other weather-exposed surfaces.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Exterior application is weather exposed, so dry conditions are potentially relevant; no sales multiplier is established.

rules.label: Roofing sheet
rules.intended_use: Installing or replacing roof covering and weather protection.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Roof installation is weather exposed, supporting provisional dry-season relevance only.

rules.label: Rain gutter/drainage component
rules.intended_use: Collecting and directing roof runoff away from buildings.
rules.seasonal_explanation: Rainfall exposes drainage failures and can prompt repair, but product-specific sales evidence is not verified.
